role: The interface MinecraftServer.tickables uses to update the server GUI's player list every tick.
scope_reason: The server GUI is never built: getGuiEnabled() is false and nothing is ever added to MinecraftServer.tickables in the oracle, so the per-tick tickables loop runs over an empty list.
notes: The tickables loop itself (MinecraftServer.updateTimeLightAndEntities) runs every tick but the list is empty.
